notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.14
notes.content:
Content Updates

Fixes player portraits for multiple character classes, sexes and ethnicities.

Adds new Trucker character class portraits.

Adds dock icons, also adds additional icon resolutions.



Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Adds a content gating framework for separating demo / early access releases.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.13
notes.content:
Content Updates

Small card flavour edits.

Capitalizes all the non-capitalized card names, slight card name changes.

Small item description edits.

Small goods description edits.

Updates towing image.

Updates some card images.

Sodankyla Trucker's Lounge background fixes.

Adds location-specific player portrait backgrounds for dialogues.

Adds crates hotspot to crates in Al-Wasal Forssa HQ.

New portrait for Kari in Forssa Trucker's Lounge.

Updates help pages to reflect changes in UI and gameplay.

Updates tutorial pages to reflect changes in UI and gameplay.

Truck in interstitials is now blue.

Makes presentation of currency consistent, always "nmk" without space, use comma in dialogue.



Gameplay Updates

Switched settings menu to use check (toggle) buttons.

Adds resolution adjustment to settings.

Adds fullscreen option.

Repair All button works with single click, and has hover state.

Adds hover indicator to party management.

Adds accept highlighting to party management.

Makes locations tooltips brighter.

Adds accept highlighting to trading.

Adds hover indicator to key bindings.

Adds hover indicator to map units.

Adds hover indicator to trade goods.

Adds hover indicator to enhancements.

Adds hover indicator to garage slots.

Adds hover indicator to point-and-click menu buttons.

Adds hover indicator to factions.

Adds hover indicator to inventory.

Adds hover indicator and tooltip for ability labels.

Adds hover indicator to arrow controls and city titles in Garage/NPC/Trade/Goods views.

Adds hover indicator to time controls.

Adds hover indicator and tooltips to map trade buttons.

Adds hover indicator to map controls.

Adds hover indicator to save/load buttons.

Adds hover indicator to location buttons.

Adds hover indicator to cards.

Adds waiting enemy collisions for heavy weapons and ramming.

Enemy waits for collisions to finish before playing more cards on its turn.

Correctly removes all modifiers from destroyed enemies.

Makes intro and game end cutscenes smoother by handling sub-pixels correctly.

Adds cooldown to enemy stack creation.

Adds card count to deck / discard views.

Makes the main menu statistics screen slightly larger so that the first achievement doesn't get cut off.

Makes flee schreech a bit quieter.

Makes flee engine sound a bit quieter.

Makes repair bang sound a bit quieter.



Bug Fixes

Fixes enemy Geoscape units being stuck in race conditions between enemy bases.

Repair All button in garage also repairs armor now.

Fixes main menu resizing glitches.

Fixes attribute changes reseting dialogue state bug.

Fixes alignment issues in parts missing/damaged Geoscape popup.

Makes sure disabled enemies don't stay disabled too long.

Fixes bug with garage inventories/buttons not updating when switching garages.



Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Adds combat ambience.

Adds crafting, i.e. selecting cards for an item when buying it from Resistance.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.12
notes.content:
Content Updates

Adds door knock SFX.

Adds more options to Malik dialogue after Sodankyla mission completion.

Adds bouncing animation to caltrops.

Adds statistics, both player and global.

Adds demo achievements.

Adds use RoadRunner SFX.

Gives player more control over Rania dialogue.

New Al-Wasal Forssa HQ background, removes bodyguards.

Tones down some of the Arabic slang in Rania/Malik dialogue.

Makes smoke shader appear in Forssa Trucker's Lounge only after the scene image has loaded.



Gameplay Updates

Adds tooltips to arrow controls, card sorting.

Adds reason for not being able to buy resource to the trade view.

Adds proper wide button to the main visual theme.

Adds "unbind all" button to card binding view.

Enables Steam Cloud Saves.



Bug Fixes

Fixes caltrops tween warnings.

Removes evade from destroyed / fled enemies.

Fixes the bug of modifiers not being correctly removed if player loses combat.

Prevents crash when leaving a location while sprite changing animation is playing.

Prevents autosaving when loading a game.

Fixes Trucker icon not showing on MacOS Steam.


Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Adds player character portraits with backgrounds removed, for later use.

Better looking ZDF Lance Rifle beam.

Adds check (switch, toggle) button to UI theme, to be used in Settings later on.

Adds correct distance computation to AI for multi-square enemies.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.11
notes.content:
Content Updates

Adds Homebound mission after failed Healing Hand.

Adds Rain/Snow shaders to Healing Hand failed cutscene.

Makes some Malik dialogue re-askable.

Adds cleaner rip tape SFX.



Gameplay Updates

Shows party in combat.

Adds a snow shader.

Triggers "Player Activity" when enemies are crashing to each other.

Makes Flee SFX a bit quieter.

Fixes enemy fire overlapping damage graphics.

DRYs pixel cross-fade shaders.

Shows a popup if nothing to repair or no scraps when fast-repairing (i.e. double-clicking repair icon in Garage view).

Adds switching shaders functionality to cutscenes.

Adds more visual indicators of movement to winter road background.



Bug Fixes

Fixes bug talking to the ZDF guards.

Prevents negative Heat.

Fixes grenade freezing bug.

Makes sure truck HPs are int in Combat.

Fixes card drag debugger errors.


Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Adds ZDF MRL (sans unique cards, AI).

Adds initial draft of Gatecrasher Pt. 2 operation.

Adds support for multi-square enemies.

Adds events on the map feature.

Adds animation for ZDF Hand-Operated Low-Yield Explosive.

Adds animation for ZDF Lance Rifle.

Makes ZDF bike correctly search for directions where player truck has armor.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.10
notes.content:
Content Updates

Allows Healing Hand to fail, adds events leading to game end with daughter dead, as well as end game cutscene.

Adds SFX to adding and removing items to inventory.

Adds SFX to Institute bribe.

Adds SFX to fleeing combat.

Adds thematic flee failed SFX.

Pixel fixes on backstory images.

Pixel fixes, screen flicker shader to Sodankyla lounge.

Adds Northern Lights, screen flicker shaders to Vaasa lounge.

Adds flicker shader to Resistance screens, better map texture in Resistance HQ.

Better looking Sisu intel chip.

Allows player to access Black Market in Sodankyla.

Rania and Malik blink now.

Deeper dialogue with Rania.

Adds pixel cross-fades to objects, items, people changing at point-and-click locations.



Gameplay Updates

Makes showing/hiding smoke shader at Forssa Trucker's Lounge faster.

More intuitive Trade View / Mini Truck cargo mapping.

Allows hiding units on the map.

Destroyed enemies damage enemy units behind them, according to their weight.

Allows attack animation to approach from both sides (front/rear) for a single enemy party.



Bug Fixes

Fixes bugs in some dialogue options in Sodankyla.

Fixes Evade bugs at the left and right edges of the combat grid.

Fixes allowing Sodankyla Smuggling completion without the cargo bug.

Prevents re-asking Markku about personal information if at the depot.


Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Adds Events feature to Geoscape.

Allows custom defeat messages for Operations.

Adds multi-stage fights.

Adds future mission-related dialogue for Malik.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.9
notes.content:
Content Updates

Adds rip tape SFX.

Adds intel chip to Sisu Compound / Crimson Mirage rewards.



Gameplay Updates

Replaces played/discarded cards to their original slots if card playing is cancelled.

Rename "Load Game" on Game Over screen to "Load Autosave" for clarification.

Prevents engaging in Operations with a broken truck.

Drones rotate between multiple targets.

Adds grayed out digits to item inventory.

Adds goods inventory to the icon, rearranges market view.

Adds combat music to enemy party dict allowing variable, enemy-based combat music.

Disables recycling of critical items on cities with no garage so player cannot soft lock themselves.

Fixes apostrophe fonts in dialogue.



 Bug Fixes

Fixes blinking glitch between the Intitute raid modals.

Keyboard shortcut for Ending Turn works now.

Prevents accidental triggering of quarry walk double-click failsafe.

Fixes binding errors with multi-target cards.

Fixes abrupt MIDI Geoscape music end.

Correctly hides and shows the smoke shader in Forssa Trucker's Lounge.

Fixes recycling in cities with no garages.

Fixes good stock not changing if the initial stock is below ten.

Fixes the stock not instantly changing when buying goods bug.



 Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

ZDF kills (i.e. causes Game Over instead of cargo looting).

Added flow for Markku diverting ZDF guards if high enough Leadership.

Allows hacking the gate at HWI HQ.

Fixes discolored pixels at HWI gate.

Fixes crashing on smaller combat grids when previewing fire.

Adds ZDF guards dialogue.

Adds narrow suburb combat background.

Adds ZDF bike SFX.

Adds HWI gate ambient.

Adds Markku diverting SFX.

Adds hacking gate SFX.

Adds getting inside the HWI compound by talking to the guards SFX.

Adds SFX for failing gate hacking.

Adds personal backstory dialogue for Markku.

Adds ZDF Lance Rifle SFX.

Adds HOLY SFX.

Prevents disabled enemies from evading.

Fixes AI ram route in smaller grids bug.

Adds Gatecrasher Pt1 images and text.

Adds custom defeat message for ZDF.

Adds evade check to ZDF bike AI to prevent playing Countermove on enemies already evading.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.8
notes.content:
Content Updates

Add and edited flavour texts.



Gameplay Updates

Adds tooltips to Factions on Party view.

Shows the reason for a garage item unavailability (no funds, scraps, inventory, or too low Machinery skill).

Locations performance improvements.

Garage performance improvements.

Combat performance improvements.

Geoscape map performance improvements.

Ensures the deck is re-created when enhancements are installed.

Better discard drag indicator in combat.

Adds SFX to flee/bribe failed.

Updated Institute stop/flee flow.  


Bug Fixes

Fixes the "Enemy cards disappear if enemy is idling" bug.

Fixes the game not pausing on popups bug.

Fixes trade good popup close button bug.

Prevents black market goods leaking into regular goods.


 Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

ZDF Assault Bike AI.

Adds inventory to garage inventory objects, and basic UI (hidden for now, as all inventories are still inifinite).

Adds hotspots to HWI gate area.

Adds Outrun combat operation type.

Adds ZDF faction.

Adds enemy Evade feature.

Adds lambdas to entering and exiting locations.

Adds variable size combat grids.

notes.title: Patch Notes Version D0.1.7
notes.content:
Content Updates

Minor dialogue updates.

Slight skill description edits.

Add nmk to Malik initial dialogue to make sure player understands nmk is a unit of currency.

Shows Sisu Sleuthing mission dialogue option on root of Sven and Stig dialogue.



Gameplay Updates

Allows longer descriptions for NPC skills in the city inventory.

Card sorting in deck view.

Don't hit enemies out of view with mines (for now, OK after decoupling animations, in which case out-of-view enemies are just hit on "code level").

Stops time when opening travel/attack dialogue on map.

Remove resolution from the settings.

Fixes performance issues on Geoscape, related to switching views.

Option to highlight plot/mission related/affecting dialogue options.

Geoscape performance improvements: Only process shown popups.

Fix the "green truck" Truck buff drag bug in combat.


Bug Fixes

Fixes bugs starting Oulu Offensive.

Fix dialogue switching bug when multiple characters.

Don't allow Old Quarry double clicking if not in use mode.

Fixes rocket targeting.


Locked Content (Content will be available in Early Access release)

Completed Markku/Truckers dialogue.

Skills for Markku (Co-pilot).

Adds Forssa Files mission.

Fix Kari post-Markku introduction dialogue flow.

Allow Markku to join party.

Adds HWI location (sans hotspots).
